implemented.storage: Existing append-only Archive; no second database or task system
implemented.weekly_identity: source week, cutoff, issue, Task and specification are fixed at claim time
implemented.atomic_claim: Same run request is idempotent; a changed issue/window/Task under the same run ID is rejected
implemented.checkpoints: Exact stage, disposition, artifact versions, external operation IDs, note and next action are append-only
implemented.idempotency: An exact checkpoint retry returns the same manifest instead of appending again
implemented.concurrency: Expected-current manifest version prevents two runners from silently overwriting each other
implemented.resume: weekly-status returns the latest durable manifest, next stage and prior checkpoint artifacts
implemented.stopped_states: BLOCKED, FAILED and UNKNOWN retain the same stage as the resume point; no automatic broadening or blind retry

automated_by_program: Weekly run identity and issue/window binding
Sequential stage checkpoints and exact artifact references
Idempotent retry and stale-writer conflict detection
Resume plan reconstruction from the Archive
Persistent status available to a new process
still_manual_or_unimplemented: GitHub Actions intelligence-weekly.yml does not exist and no real schedule has been enabled
Source feed/channel configuration and rights intake still require explicit inputs
The full SOURCE→RESEARCH→REVIEW→EDITION pipeline is not invoked by one automatic runner
Independent reviewer execution is not yet an admitted model operation inside the weekly run
GitHub-hosted private persistent storage, backup and independent watchdog are not configured
External delivery authorization and receipt handling remain separate and unauthorized
